Fast and tanky with Giant bosses in the back.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 28 ([[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} {{QuoteBox|Incoming tank zombies!|Beginning of Wave 28 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Rusher''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, replacing the [[Hazard]]. In [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, the '''Rusher''' replaced the [[Hazard]] and was significantly faster, matching the speed of the [[Glitch]] with its shield while also boasting far more health. However, once the '''Rusher's''' health dropped to half, it lost its shield and became much slower. Previously, the '''Rusher''' was spawned by the [[Nuclear Fallen King]] and the [[Mystery]] upon their death from Wave 29 onward. ==Appearance== The '''Rusher''' was similar to the [[Hazard]] and [[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)|Fallen Rusher]]. However, it had a grey hazmat suit with more coverings and a tactical vest. It had a green reflective and translucent riot shield that it ran with. While the shield appeared in front of the '''Rusher''', it did not negate damage. It also had diamond-plated black knee pads, gloves and boots. ==Strategy== *Reduce the '''Rusher's''' health down to half health in order to slow it down. *As they appear in large numbers, a [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] may be required to tackle these. **However, due to these towers' slow projectile speed, they might not be able to hit '''Rushers'''. ***You may need to set these towers to target ''Closest'' to have a higher chance in hitting the '''Rusher'''. *High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] or [[Minigunner]], will be required to tackle '''Rushers'''. **Due to the '''Rusher's''' high speed and high health, the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] may also be required to boost firerate and increase the range of towers, respectively. *You can use the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] to slow down '''Rushers'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TDSArsenal.jpg|'''Rusher''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} B80E22C4-878F-46FB-A695-372D924C9FF4.png|'''Rusher''' on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *This is the second [[Enemies|enemy]] to have a negative downgrade when it loses health, after the [[Beehive]]. *The '''Rusher''' and its animation is closely related to R2DA's [[w:c:r2da:Halloween Costumes 2019|Halloween 2019]] [[w:c:r2da:Ticker|Ticker]]. *A Hardcore variant of the '''Rusher''' exists, the [[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)|Fallen Rusher]]. **The '''Rusher''' has more health, but the [[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)|Fallen Rusher]] is much faster, having a speed of 15 while the '''Rusher''' as 12. *Before the Overhaul Update, the '''Rusher''' could appear in regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode when the [[Mystery]] died from wave 29 onwards. *The '''Rusher's''' mask is the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/16725421/ Fire Fighter Hazard Mask] accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Rusher''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Rusher''' can now be spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death in regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Rusher''' can no longer be spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death in regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Rusher''' removed. {{FallenNuclear|[[Glitch]]|Wave 26|Rusher|Wave 28|[[Tank]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Rusher}}
